{{*}} [[Tele Group Moonclan]]
{{*}} [[Lunar isle teleport]] |music = [[The Lunar Isle]] |map = {{Map|name=Lunar Isle|x=2117|y=3903|width=300|height=300|zoom=1}} |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} [[File:Lunar Isle icon detail.png|left|130px]] {{Relativelocation |location = Lunar Isle |east = Fremennik Isles |south = Tirannwn |west = Winter's Edge }} '''Lunar Isle''' is a crescent-shaped island located in the [[Northern Ocean]], occupied by the ancient [[Moon Clan]]. The island becomes accessible to [[members]] who have progressed far enough into the [[Lunar Diplomacy]] [[Quests|quest]]. A [[Seal of Passage]] is required to interact with all [[Non-player character|NPC]]'s on the island except [['Birds-Eye' Jack]]. Players who do so without one equipped or in their inventory will be teleported to [[Rellekka]]. Completing the elite tier of the [[Fremennik Diary]] removes the need for a seal, adding a [[Return Orb]] to the bank which can be used to return to Rellekka if desired. ==Transportation== There are two methods for teleporting to Lunar Isle: * {{Plink|Lunar Home Teleport}} and {{Plink|Moonclan Teleport}} — entrance to the residential area. * {{Plink|Lunar isle teleport|txt=Lunar Isle teleport}} — centre of the residential area. Beyond that, players may talk to to [[Lokar Searunner]] on the western-most dock of [[Rellekka]] to be taken to [[Pirates' Cove]], then go up to the [[Lady Zay|pirate ship]] and talk to [[Captain Bentley]] to go on to Lunar Isle. A number of teleports to Rellekka exist, including: * {{Plink|Fremennik sea boots 1}} — centre of the Rellekka marketplace. * {{Plink|Enchanted lyre}} — Rellekka's southern entrance. * {{Plink|Teleport to House}} — [[Portal (Player-owned house)|POH portal]] just south of Rellekka. * {{Plink|Achievement diary cape|txt=Diary cape}} — just south of the POH portal. ==History== In the [[Second Age]],{{CiteVideo|author=Old School RuneScape|title=The Most Powerful Artefact In RuneScape {{!}} Stone of Jas|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4SQb6lH29x4&t=97|timestamp=1:37|date=5 July 2024|site=|notes=|name=}} the [[Fremennik]] seer [[V]] founded the [[Moon Clan]] after he discovered the [[Stone of Jas]] in a cave on Lunar Isle. He also discovered the art of [[Runecraft|runecrafting]] and travelled across the world with his followers, constructing [[Runic altar|altars]] at places of power.{{CiteNPC|npc=Baba Yaga|loc=Lunar Diplomacy|quote=The Fremennik were actually the first to discover how to make runes.}}{{CiteNPC|npc=Baba Yaga|loc=Lunar Diplomacy|quote=[V] and his followers built altars all over Gielinor - which you use today to create runes}} Most other Fremenniks disagreed with the crafting of [[runes]], feeling like it was stealing power from the gods, and so the Moon Clan split off from the Fremennik.{{CiteText|text=Display case (Varrock Museum, number 2)|quote=The Fremennik mountain tribe has always been opposed to the manufacture of runes, as they feel this should be the work of the gods.|name=manufacture}}{{CiteText|text=Moonclan manual|quote=We [the Moon Clan] of course take the more enlightened view that we should use all tools at our disposal for our own betterment.}} This later resulted in a conflict between the two groups, with the Fremennik forcing the Moon Clan to retreat to Lunar Isle where they have lived ever since.{{CiteNPC|npc=Baba Yaga|loc=Lunar Diplomacy|quote=The Fremennik had grown strong in body, while our clan had grown strong in mind. They overpowered our tribe and we retreated to Lunar Isle, where we have lived ever since.}} Over time, their knowledge of the rune altar locations faded away, while their magical abilities advanced to the point where they no longer need runes to focus their magic.{{CiteText|text=Baba Yaga|quote=Our people were left isolated on Lunar Isle but we used it to our advantage. Our control over Magic advanced beyond the need for runes and all knowledge of the altar locations passed from memory.}} In the [[Fifth Age]], an [[Player character|adventurer]] who had previously been accepted into the Fremenniks voyaged to Lunar Isle in hopes of ending the rivalry. After [[Lunar Diplomacy#Part 3 - Dream World|completing a dream ritual]], the player is accepted by the Moon Clan as well, and initiates the process of reconciliation between the two clans. ==Locations== === Buildings === {| class="wikitable" !Building !Description |- |[[Baba Yaga's Magic Shop.|Baba Yaga's Magic Shop]] |A walking house and store run by Baba Yaga. The store sells high-level runes and [[Battlestaff|battlestaves]]. |- |Brazier hall |A large, open building containing the [[Lectern (Lunar)|Lunar lectern]] (used to create [[magic tablets]] of [[teleportation spells]] in the [[Lunar spellbook]]), and the [[Ceremonial Brazier|ceremonial brazier]]. |- |[[Lunar Isle bank]] |A branch of the [[Bank|Bank of Geilinor]]. Players who have completed [[Dream Mentor]] can speak to [['Birds-Eye' Jack]] to bank here without needing a [[Seal of Passage]]. |- |[[Meteora]]'s home |A large building with four beds, found just north of the [[Water Source|water source]]. |- |[[Moon Clan Fine Clothes.|Moon Clan Fine Clothes]] |A large building selling [[Moonclan robes]], owned by [[Rimae Sirsalis|Rimae]] who lives on the floor above. |- |[[Moon Clan General Store.|Moon Clan General Store]] |A store which buys from players for higher prices than usual [[General store|general stores]]. |- |[[Pauline Polaris|Polaris]]' house |A small house just west of the brazier hall. |} There are also three empty homes in the village. === Skill training areas === * [[Astral Altar|Astral altar]] - Used to switch to the [[Lunar spellbook|Lunar Spellbook]], or make [[astral rune]]s with the [[Runecraft]] skill. * [[Lunar Isle mine]] - The mine contains two [[rune essence]] rocks in the centre, 7 [[gold rocks]], 5 [[silver rocks]], and 4 [[gem rocks]]. * [[Suqah|Suqahs]] - a number of suqahs can be found around the island. They are most concentrated in the northeastern tip of the island. * In the building just west of the bank is a [[cooker]], which functions like a range. While there are closer locations to a bank, this offers secluded and peaceful location to train, which is still close to a bank. There is also a [[sink]] in the building. === Spawns === While there are no direct spawns on the island, there are several objects that can be interacted with for items. There are [[flax]] fields outside the main gates, and several barrels around the island which can be [[Barrel (cooking apples)|searched for apples]] or [[Tar barrel|for tar]]. ==Sailing info== Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at the Lunar Isle with level 76 [[Sailing]], provided they have also completed [[Lunar Diplomacy]]. The dock at the south-east of the island offers the following utilities for sailors, though many are unusable until the quest is completed: *[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]] *[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]] *[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]] *[[File:Bank icon.png|link=Bank deposit box]] [[Bank deposit box]] ===Port tasks=== The notice board offers eight [[port tasks]] selected from the following lists. '''[[Bounty tasks]]''' {{BountyTaskList|location=Lunar Isle}} '''[[Courier tasks]]''' {{CourierTaskList|location=Lunar Isle}} ==Inhabitants== *{{Chatl|Baba Yaga}} *{{Chatl|Bedread the bold}} *{{Chatl|'Beedy-eye' Jones|text=Beedy-eye Jones}} *{{Chatl|'Beefy' Burns|text=Beefy Burns}} *{{Chatl|'Betty' B.Boppin|text=Betty B.Boppin}} *{{Chatl|'Birds-Eye' Jack|text=Birds-Eye Jack}} *{{Chatl|Bouquet Mac Hyacinth}} *{{Chatl|Cabin boy}} *{{Chatl|Captain Bentley}} *{{Chatl|Cyrisus}} *{{Chatl|'Eagle-eye' Shultz|text=Eagle-eye Shultz}} *{{Chatl|First mate 'Davey-boy'|text=First mate Davey-boy}} *{{Chatl|Jack Sails}} *{{Chatl|Jenny Blade}} *{{Chatl|'Lecherous' Lee|text=Lecherous Lee}} *{{Chatl|Murky Pat}} *{{Chatl|Melana Moonlander}} *{{Chatl|Meteora}} *{{Chatl|Oneiromancer}} *{{Chatl|Pauline Polaris}} *{{Chatl|'Picarron' Pete|text=Picarron Pete}} *{{Chatl|Rimae Sirsalis}} * {{Chatl|Selene}} * {{Chatl|Tommy 2-times}} === Monsters === The only monsters on the island are [[suqah]], which use [[magic]] and [[melee]] attacks. There are a total of 26 on the island, with a 27th in a cage below the deck of the [[Lady Zay|''Lady Zay'']]. Interestingly, however, a [[clue scroll]] step given by the [[Oneiromancer]] asks how many suqahs are on the island, but requires the answer of 25. == Quests == * [[Dragon Slayer II]] * [[Dream Mentor]] * [[The Fremennik Exiles]] * [[Lunar Diplomacy]] ==Music== {| class="wikitable sortable" !Name ! class="unsortable" |Unlock location ! class="unsortable" |Music track |- |[[Isle of Everywhere]] |Northern Lunar Isle |[[File:Isle of Everywhere.ogg]] |- |[[The Lunar Isle]] |Lunar Isle |[[File:The Lunar Isle.ogg]] |- |[[Way of the Enchanter]] |Lunar Isle mine |[[File:Way of the Enchanter.ogg]] |} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 14 March 2019 |update = Updated Quest Panel, Sandstone Grinder and QoL |change = Some cooking ranges on Lunar Isle were not working as ranges, and have been fixed. }} {{Subject changes footer}} == References == {{Reflist}} {{Lunar Diplomacy}} {{Dream Mentor}} {{Lunar Isle}} [[Category:Fremennik]]
